Subject: Procurement readiness & next steps — Clearwater Biosystems / Redwood

Hi Tom / Emily,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about the pilot scope and Clearwater's timeline. Quick recap + suggested mutual action plan so we can keep procurement moving without surprises. Please flag anything missing.

Call recap (short):
- Pilot: 3-node hosted plan (dev -> staging -> prod), estimated monthly token volumes ~2.5M tokens.
- Primary concerns: legal SLA window, SOC2 evidence for security, invoice/PO flow for finance.
- Commercial path options: PO with monthly invoicing (preferred), corporate card for initial pilot, or marketplace purchase if clearing internal requirements.

Proposed procurement milestones & ETA (high-level):
1) Legal review (Receive contract redlines) — target: 3 business days after we send MSA draft
2) Security review (SOC2 + questionnaire) — target: 5 business days after SOC2/Q completion
3) Finance (W-9, vendor setup) — target: 2-4 business days once vendor packet submitted
4) PO issuance & onboarding kickoff — target: within 2 business days after PO receipt

Immediate next steps (mutual action items):
- Redwood: attach a redline-ready MSA + SOC2 report snapshot and W-9 (attached).
- Clearwater: share preferred procurement route (PO vs card vs marketplace) and attach your PO template if you want us to prefill.
- Set a short 30-min follow-up for procurement owners: suggest Mon 11/22 or Tue 11/23.

Attachments included: Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan template), SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted), Redwood_W-9.pdf.

If PO is the path, we can prefill the vendor details and return a draft for your procurement/legal to review — that typically accelerates finance onboarding.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben on pricing/discount alignment and Lauren on contract gates.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — useful recap. A few clarifying questions from our side before we loop legal/finance: 

1) SOC2: can you share the SOC2 Type II report or an auditor letter? A redacted snapshot is fine; our security team wants the evidence and the date range.
2) Contract: will the MSA include our standard data processing addendum? We will likely request specific language on data residency and breach notifications.
3) Marketplace: we are evaluating whether to buy via marketplace (faster for small pilots) — can you confirm which SKU would map to the 3-node pilot and if pricing differs materially?

Attached: our standard PO template (Procurement_PO_template.pdf) — if you can prefill vendor details and send back, that will speed up vendor onboarding. Also can you provide Redwood’s W-9 (if you didn’t already)?

We prefer PO for production, but we may run the first month on a card to avoid delays. Looking to have procurement owner review next week.

Appreciate it —
Tom
Director of IT Procurement
Clearwater Biosystems

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procurement readiness & next steps — Clearwater Biosystems / Redwood

Quick answers — see timeline guidance and recommended responses below. I’ll also attach a prefilled PO draft by EOD.

Pricing / commercial: 
- For a 3-node hosted pilot we should propose the Pilot SKU (HST-3PILOT) at 25% off list for months 1-2 to remove friction. Standard monthly rate would apply after pilot.
- Marketplace SKU is functionally equivalent but lists at gross rate (no pilot credit). If Clearwater wants marketplace for speed, we can book a one-off marketplace coupon for the pilot month to approximate the 25% pilot rate.

Legal / MSA: 
- We can start with Redwood’s standard MSA + DPA.
- Data residency requests: we do not currently guarantee regional-only residency on hosted plans; we can offer contract language about notice windows and access controls but cannot accept strict residency-only clauses unless they move to Private deployment.
- Key redlines we cannot accept: perpetual indemnity beyond mutual indemnities, and broad liability caps changes. Anything else is negotiable.

Security evidence: 
- SOC2 Type II report: we will provide a redacted SOC2 Type II cover letter and control summary (redacted PII sections) — target: same day delivery to Tom (today).
- We can also provide a completed security questionnaire if Clearwater sends the template.

Finance / PO flow: 
- W-9: Aditya already attached (good).
- Vendor setup: once PO received we provide invoice net-30 (default) unless they request net-45/60 and finance approves.
- Prefill approach: I’ll prefill their PO template with vendor name, address, tax info and the Pilot SKU + pricing (attached).

Estimated internal ETA (from receipt of their PO template and confirmation):
- Legal redlines complete: 3 business days
- Security evidence provided: same day (we will send redacted SOC2)
- Finance vendor setup + invoice: 2-3 business days after prefilled PO returned
- Expected onboarding kickoff: within 2 business days after PO issuance

Action items I’ll take: prefill their PO (attach by EOD), send redacted SOC2, and draft a one-page pilot amendment language to accelerate signature.

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood
(attachment stubs: Prefilled_Clearwater_PO.pdf, Pilot_Amendment_Draft.docx)
